title: The Dataset Multiplicity Problem: How Unreliable Data Impacts Predictions
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this was not a subject of its analysis. The study focuses on how data inaccuracies impact machine learning predictions, with a specific focus on disparate impacts across demographic groups defined by race and gender.
